_about: T994 #5 / #26 (AGENTS 40: a rule in both languages has ONE shared fixture). What the feeds worker and its Python twin do with a STORED STATE FILE that is absent, torn or the wrong shape: absent is a first run; anything else that does not read fails, naming the file, and nothing empty is written back. Read by app/workers/feeds/test/state-reads.test.ts (src/gauges/publish.ts tempHistoryOf / stationFileOf, src/notify.ts sendDue) and pipeline/tests/test_feed_state_reads.py (pipeline/gauges/feed/publish.py _stored_json, notify.py send_due). `stored` null = no file. `error` is a substring of the raised message (the parser's own words follow it in parentheses and differ by language).
